68cdef void _mr_dealloc_callback( 

69 object mr, 

70 cydriver.CUdeviceptr ptr, 

71 size_t size, 

72 const StreamHandle& h_stream, 

73) noexcept: 

74 """Called by the C++ deleter to deallocate via MemoryResource.deallocate. 

75  

76 Runs from a destructor, so nothing can be raised here; failures are reported 

77 as :class:`~cuda.core.CUDAWarning` (see the error handling policy).

291 """Create a Buffer from a raw pointer. 

292  

293 When ``mr`` is provided, the buffer takes ownership: ``mr.deallocate()`` 

294 is called when the buffer is closed or garbage collected. When ``owner`` 

295 is provided, the owner is kept alive but no deallocation is performed. 

296 When ``mr`` is provided, a deallocation stream is recorded at creation 

297 (``stream`` if given, otherwise ``default_stream()``). Recording a 

298 default-stream token requires a CUDA context to be current. Host-only 

299 resources (``mr.is_device_accessible`` is ``False``) record no stream 

300 and need no context. 

301 """

340 @staticmethod 

341 def _reduce_helper(mr, ipc_descriptor): 

342 cdef ContextHandle h_ctx = get_current_context() 

343 cdef int device_id 

344 if not h_ctx: 

345 # Spawned processes unpickle arguments before entering their target, 

346 # so initialize the context needed to bind the default-stream token. 

347 device_id = mr.device_id 

348 (Device(device_id) if device_id >= 0 else Device()).set_current() 

349 # The parent process's stream is not portable across processes, so the 

350 # pickle path cannot thread an explicit stream through. Seed the 

351 # imported buffer's deallocation with the current context's default 

352 # stream; the receiver can override it before or during close. 

353 return Buffer.from_ipc_descriptor(mr, ipc_descriptor, stream=default_stream())

781cdef class MemoryResource: 

782 """Abstract base class for memory resources that manage allocation and 

783 deallocation of buffers. 

784  

785 Subclasses must implement methods for allocating and deallocation, as well 

786 as properties associated with this memory resource from which all allocated 

787 buffers will inherit. (Since all :class:`Buffer` instances allocated and 

788 returned by the :meth:`allocate` method would hold a reference to self, the 

789 buffer properties are retrieved simply by looking up the underlying memory 

790 resource's respective property.) 

791 """ 

792  

793 def allocate(self, size_t size, *, stream: Stream | GraphBuilder) -> Buffer: 

794 """Allocate a buffer of the requested size. 

795  

796 Parameters 

797 ---------- 

798 size : int 

799 The size of the buffer to allocate, in bytes. 

800 stream : :obj:`~_stream.Stream` | :obj:`~graph.GraphBuilder` 

801 Keyword-only. The stream on which to perform the allocation 

802 asynchronously. Must be passed explicitly; pass 

803 ``device.default_stream`` to use the default stream. For subclasses 

804 that support stream-ordered deallocation, this stream also orders 

805 the buffer's eventual deallocation, so if the buffer may be freed 

806 from a different host thread, prefer a stream other than the 

807 per-thread default stream, which refers to a different stream on 

808 each thread. 

809  

810 Returns 

811 ------- 

812 Buffer 

813 The allocated buffer object, which can be used for device or host operations 

814 depending on the resource's properties. 

815 """ 

816 raise TypeError("MemoryResource.allocate must be implemented by subclasses.") 2.i
